prompt: How many more points did Michael Jordan average in his sophomore season (regular season) in the NBA than the first black NBA player averaged during his career (regular season)? Show me a math equation to justify your answer.
answer:
The first Black player to appear in an NBA game was **Earl Lloyd**, who averaged **8.4 points per game** over his regular-season career. Michael Jordan averaged **22.7 points per game** in his sophomore season (1985–86).

\[
22.7 - 8.4 = \boxed{14.3}
\]

**Michael Jordan averaged 14.3 more points per game.**
